figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Phylogenetic analysis of the BIA SyOMTs mined from the transcriptomic data of S. yunnanensis and their biochemical assays. A. Phylogenetic tree of 
representative BIA 6OMTs, 7OMTs, 4′OMTs, 3′OMTs, SOMTs together with the five BIA OMTs (SyOMT1 to SyOMT5, blue filled cycle) mined from the transcriptomic 
data of S, yunnanensis. B. The transformation relationship of compounds 1–5 in this study. C. In vitro assays of SyOMT1-OMT5 with compound 1. D. In vitro assays of 
SyOMT1-OMT5 with compound 2. E. In vitro assays of SyOMT1-OMT5 with compound 3. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this figure legend, the 
reader is referred to the web version of this article.)

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Protein engineering of SyOMT4 and in vitro assays of its mutants. A. Overlapping the model of SyOMT4/(S)-coclaurine (2) with the crystal structure of 
Tf6OMT/SAH/norlaudanosoline (NLS) (PDB 5ICE) [12] Colors: SyOMT4 in cyan; Tf6OMT in green; SAH in yellow; NLS in orange; (S)-coclaurine in magenta. B. The 
possible interactions within the model of SyOMT4 and its ligands SAH and (S)-coclaurine (2). C. In vitro biochemical assays of SyOMT4 mutants with substrate 2. D. In 
vitro biochemical assays of SyOMT4 mutants with substrate 1. E. The possible interactions within the model of SyOMT4-WFE and its ligands SAH and (S)-norco­
claurine (1). Colors: SyOMT4-WFE in cyan; SAH in yellow; (S)-norcoclaurine in green. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this figure legend, the reader 
is referred to the web version of this article.)

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Protein engineering of SyOMT5 and in vitro assays of its mutants. A. Overlapping the model of SyOMT5/(S)-coclaurine (2) with the crystal structure of 
Tf6OMT/SAH/norlaudanosoline (NLS) (PDB 5ICE). Colors: SyOMT5 in wheat; Tf6OMT in green; SAH in yellow; NLS in orange; (S)-coclaurine in magenta. B. The 
possible interactions within the model of SyOMT5 and its ligand SAH and (S)-coclaurine (2). C. In vitro biochemical assays of SyOMT5 mutants with substrate 3. D. In 
vitro biochemical assays of SyOMT5 mutants with substrate 2. E. The possible interactions within the model of SyOMT5-WFE and its ligand SAH and (S)-coclaurine 
(2). (For interpretation of the references to colour in this figure legend, the reader is referred to the web version of this article.)

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5. The overlapped models of SyOMT4-WFE/(S)-norcoclaurine (1) and SyOMT5-WFE/(S)-coclaurine (2) and in vitro assays of switched mutants. A. Overlapping 
the models of SyOMT4-WFE/(S)-norcoclaurine (1) with SyOMT5-WFE/(S)-coclaurine (2). Colors: SyOMT4-WFE in cyan; SyOMT5-WFE in wheat; (S)-norcoclaurine in 
green; (S)-coclaurine in magenta. B. In vitro biochemical assays of SyOMT4-WFE and its mutants with 1 as substrate. C. In vitro biochemical assays of SyOMT4-WFE 
and its mutants with 2 as substrate. D. In vitro biochemical assays of SyOMT5-WFE and its mutants with 1 as substrate. E. In vitro biochemical assays of SyOMT5-WFE 
and its mutants with 2 as substrate. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this figure legend, the reader is referred to the web version of this article.)
